name: posthog-js-slim-no-external
description: Subpath entry point for the tree-shakeable core bundle that ships no external script loader, the combination desktop apps and strict CSP sites need. Extensions come from posthog-js/dist/extension-bundles through the __extensionClasses config; nothing is loaded from the CDN. ESM-only, like the extension bundles it composes with; consumed by bundlers via the `module` field. Types come from dist/module.slim.no-external.d.ts, which marks each tree-shakeable extension as possibly undefined because the site chooses which ones to include.
